headline: Executive order addresses how a 2024 law on apps controlled by foreign adversaries will be applied to TikTok.
what_it_does: This order concerns how the government will apply the Protecting Americans From Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act to TikTok. That 2024 law targets apps controlled by foreign adversaries and names TikTok. No summary was provided, so the specific instructions in the order, such as how or when the law will be enforced, cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: People in the US who use TikTok
who_it_affects.how: The order may affect whether and when TikTok stays available to them under the 2024 law.
The order deals with how the law's rules on foreign adversary control are applied to the company.

who_it_affects.group: App stores and internet hosting companies
who_it_affects.how: The 2024 law places duties on companies that distribute or host covered apps, so the order may affect what they are expected to do.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
